name: dea-catalog-business-capabilities
description: Business Capability Catalog (CR-DEA-BC-01). The release pipeline renders an L0 ⊃ L1 ⊃ L2 nested ECF capability map (HTML + A3 landscape PNG) on every v* tag push via the framework Python (scripts/generate_capability_map.py). Distribution is GitHub Releases only.
